title: Fox finds Marco Chereze's sister Marta

plain: While looking into reports that a living creature was captured in Varginha, Brazil, James Fox says he went searching for the family of Marco Chereze. Fox tells Michels that after knocking on doors for about four hours, "door opens. There's Marcos's sister, Marta," meaning Marta Tavares, which put him in touch with someone close to the story.
